# Engineer Assessment: product and research model

**Historical Lab authoring snapshot.** The editable product and research workspace is now [Engineer Assessment](../../../../../../engineer-assessment/README.md). This Lab copy and its Define v2 packages preserve the original exact source cut; later workspace edits require a new capture.

Status: **candidate authoring package, 2026-10-25**. Owner acceptance, canonical definition admission, live Define host selection, research participation, employment use, and publication are separate future decisions. This package has authority effect `none`.

## One coherent proposition

For a specified software-engineering role and level, test whether **at most three recorded case sessions, each at most ten minutes**, can identify later high-performing engineers at least as well as a longer hiring process. Session 1 uses riddles and unusual problems to elicit creativity, analysis, and ingenuity. Session 2 elicits product and software design judgment. Session 3 elicits cooperation and communication judgment. A public challenge gives participants useful feedback and supplies consented research evidence. The hiring claim is an experimental hypothesis until independently validated.

## Definition and lifecycle boundary

The current Lab [Product](../../../../lab/reference/records/def-cal-definition-product.md), [Product Thesis](../../../../lab/reference/records/def-cal-definition-product-thesis.md), [Research Inquiry](../../../../lab/reference/records/def-cal-definition-research-inquiry.md), [Experiment Design](../../../../lab/reference/records/def-cal-definition-experiment-design.md), [Measurement Method](../../../../lab/reference/records/def-cal-definition-measurement-method.md), [Authority](../../../../lab/reference/records/def-cal-definition-authority.md), [Evidence](../../../../lab/reference/records/def-cal-definition-evidence.md), and [Product Capability](../../../../lab/reference/records/def-cal-definition-product-capability.md) meanings are reused by exact registry selection in the assessment Define request. Project (`CAV2-D60`) and Goal (`CAV2-D59`) are selected in the second request. The sixteen assessment-specific terms are proposed local meanings. No proposal changes the canonical registry.

Define v2 is an explicit local preparation candidate. Its `doctor` result on this worktree reported `runtime_integrity=verified`, `preparation=available`, `live_host=requires-independent-selection-and-qualification`, and `release_adopted=false`. The Pack can demonstrate exact input closure and reconstruction; it cannot admit meanings or qualify an employment decision.

## Decisions still owned by people

The owner must select the first role and level, product name, intended geography, research budget, identity and data-retention policy, and the employer participation route. These are recorded as open inputs, not invented approvals. Research can develop candidate cases and protocols before those decisions, with study claims scoped accordingly.
